_meta.reality_check: User has NO credit card, NO phone verification possible in many cases. After live test on Cerebras (2026-07-23), all 3 'free' models returned 402 Payment Required. Gemma direct API also requires newer `google-genai` SDK not installed. EFFECTIVELY: only Groq + skill-first works without friction.
_meta.recommendation: Use tier 0 (skills library) for 80% of work. Use Groq (tier 1) only when skills don't fit. Ollama only if user installs it later.
